title: AlphaEvolve: Evolutionary Coding Agent & 48-Multiplication 4×4 Matrix Algorithm
whyItMatters: First AI coding agent to simultaneously break a 56-year mathematical record (Strassen's 1969 4×4 matrix bound) and optimize production data centers and chip circuits.
summary: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaEvolve, an evolutionary coding agent pairing Gemini LLMs with automated evaluators to iteratively mutate and verify entire codebases. Across 50+ open math problems it matched or improved state-of-the-art constructions—most famously finding a 48-scalar-multiplication algorithm for 4×4 complex matrices (beating Strassen's 49 from 1969)—while also recovering 0.7% of Google's worldwide compute via scheduling heuristics and speeding up FlashAttention and TPU matrix circuits.
technicalHighlights: Discovered a provably exact rank-48 algorithm for multiplying 4×4 complex-valued matrices, improving on Strassen's 1969 record over ℂ.
Improved best-known mathematical bounds on ~20% of 50+ open problems (including kissing numbers in 11D).
Deployed directly into production at Google for Borg scheduling, TPU Verilog optimization, and Gemini training kernels.
caveats: Requires a fast, automated objective evaluator; excels on optimization, constructive math, and verifiable code rather than open-ended physical theory without formal metrics.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrated general-purpose autonomous algorithm discovery spanning both pure mathematics and real-world systems engineering.
scoreRationale.ripple: Established the LLM + verifier evolutionary search paradigm now powering quantum circuit design, hardware synthesis, and scientific discovery.
scoreRationale.verification: The 48-multiplication factorization and evolved kernels are algebraically and programmatically verified, with independent GitHub verifications.
scoreRationale.velocity: Cracked a 56-year-old algebraic complexity record while shipping measurable global infrastructure speedups.
